label: Hybrid Rendering Thesis
bulletPoints: Master's Thesis which describes how one can leverage spherical harmonics and light probes as a basis for a hybrid-rendered shader
Boasts a stabler framerate (p95) than a pure dynamic shader by ~3ms

label: Slime Simulation
bulletPoints: Interactive slime mold simulation using p5.js.
Features agent-based modeling and trail following.

label: GOAP Agent
bulletPoints: Goal-Oriented Action Planning Agent which is able to play a recreation of the game Fireboy and Watergirl.
Able to dynamically react and plan actions based on player input and game states.

label: Python Web-Crawler
bulletPoints: Web crawling tool built in Python using Playwright MCP
Capable of scraping and parsing Amazon content given user input
Features customizable scraping rules and data extraction.

label: Barnsley Fern
bulletPoints: Fractal generation using iterated function systems.
Draws the famous Barnsley Fern in real time.
